reviews.title: You keep breaking things
reviews.text: My guy, I don’t know what is so hard about this. You finally fixed the sticky scrolling velocity after like 3 or 4 months, but now when I click the “Read More” button at the end of a post it switches to my default Safari iOS browser instead of so to in the Feeder app. Why do you keep changing existing functionality? Why do you keep breaking things that were working? You had a perfectly functioning app and are mucking it up. This app was best when you didn’t make any updates.

reviews.title: Feels unfinished, needs improvement
reviews.text: Good looking interface but there are issues. Shouldn’t have to give an email/make an account to use in free mode, cloud storage of feed should be opt in. Also no mechanism to delete account in the app. It’s not clear what the subscription gets you/what you don’t get without it, other than the every minute updates with the highest tier. The restriction on how soon the feed can update makes the app pretty worthless at least on the free tier, and $100 a year is an insane amount to pay for an RSS reader. It’d make more sense to have the subscription for quicker background feed updates/notifications but allow unlimited in app feed updates.
